record.dic_text:
0295 'Achiy`ezer {a-khi:-e'-zer}

源自 0251 和 05828; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Ahiezer 6; 6

亞希以謝 = "我兄弟是幫助"
1) 一位協助摩西的但族首領
2) 一位但族首領, 大衛的勇士之一 (#代上 12:3|)
record.edic_text:
0295 'Achiy`ezer {akh-ee-eh'-zer}

from 0251 and 05828;; n pr m

AV - Ahiezer 6; 6

Ahiezer = "my brother is help"
1) a Danite chief who assisted Moses
2) a Danite chief, one of David's heroes
